source.note: Facts were extracted from the 17 legacy PSC files and the ESP VMAD; no FormID or default value was invented.

records.identityScope: legacy-menu-identification-only; MCM Papyrus functions are excluded

notes: The ESP has the 0x200 (ESL) flag and six masters; form IDs below are the values stored in the file.
recordFlags is the TES4 record-header flags field (header offset 8). All 58 records are 0x00000000 in this uncompressed plugin; this is not the quest gameplay flags.

For QUST, quest gameplay flags live in the DNAM subrecord. questFlags is the little-endian uint16 at DNAM+0; 0x00000111 means kEnabled (1<<0) | kStartsEnabled (1<<4) | kRunOnce (1<<8) per RE/T/TESQuest.h.
VMAD property values are decoded from the quest/effect scripts; object values are recorded as alias/formId.
